wall_heat_transfer: Adiabatic; no condensation, radiation, skin or internal vortex modeled.
status: Conceptual assumptions; no measured AA boundary conditions.
density_model: Boussinesq; constant density in continuity, linear variation for buoyancy
temperature_interpretation: Approximate total temperature; kinetic-energy recovery omitted from PDE. At target speeds this correction is small; near compact outlet it can approach 2 K.
buoyancy_density_approximation: 20 K range / 298.15 K = 6.7%; source uncertainty larger. Not calibrated.
convection_scheme: Bounded first-order upwind, matching the coarse final settings.
numerical_phase: Refined mesh, mapped from completed coarse solution. Not independently validated.
mesh_check_scope: Refined-mesh spot check: 100 higher-order initialization iterations, then 50 iterations at matched first-order settings. Not a converged grid-independence demonstration.
